blocks.h2: How an Overhead Sewer System Works
blocks.body: Every drain below the street sewer's flow line, like your floor drain, a basement bathroom, or a laundry line, normally relies on gravity to reach the sewer. An overhead sewer system reroutes those drains into a sump pit instead. An [ejector pump](/chicago-ravenswood/ejector-pump) lifts that wastewater up to a line above flood level, where a check valve keeps it from flowing back down. From there, gravity carries it the rest of the way to the street sewer, the same as every drain upstairs.

blocks.intro: In July 2011, record rainfall flooded basements across Ravenswood. According to MWRD, two-thirds of an inch of rain in an hour can overwhelm Chicago's sewers.

items.body: Below-grade apartments are the most exposed space in the building.
We plan the pit and pipe path carefully in century-old basements.
A blocked lateral can cause backups too. A [sewer repair](/chicago-ravenswood/sewer-repair) may be enough.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Turning a basement into a garden apartment, or protecting one that already exists, often means an overhead sewer. Every fixture in the unit drains to a sealed pit, and the pump lifts the waste above flood level. In older Chicago buildings, we plan the route around low ceilings, old foundation walls and existing ductwork. We also size the pump for the unit's fixtures, so a full bathroom, kitchen and laundry all drain without strain.

blocks.h2: Overhead Sewer Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Can a garden unit kitchen and bath work with an overhead sewer?
items.answer: Yes. All basement fixtures drain to the new pit, and the pump lifts the wastewater out.

items.q: What happens in a power outage?
items.answer: The pump needs power, so a battery backup or generator is worth considering.

items.q: Does it stop seepage through the walls?
items.answer: No. That's groundwater, a separate problem.
Usually a few days, depending on the layout and fixtures.

items.q: Does an overhead sewer work for a whole two-flat?
items.answer: It protects the basement level, where backups happen. Upper units drain as they always have.

items.q: How much does an overhead sewer cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on your basement. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on sewer depth, layout, fixtures and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
